title: Complex localization of the open restriction square
statement:
For any complex I, the explicit restriction-localization chain followed by the inverse derived restriction comparison is the derived Y-restriction of the h-localization unit. No open direct image, image-component map, K-injectivity, or representative e occurs. Transport the forward homotopy unit equation to complexes; postcompose with G of the inverse X-restriction factor and with the inverse derived restriction comparison, canceling their hom/inverse pairs. Definitions: [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data], [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data], [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-open-counit-model], [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-restriction-localization-chain]. Exact Lean statement:
theorem schemeMV_image_restriction_localization
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    (schemeMVRestrictionLocalizationChain X Y h W I) ≫
      (schemeMVOpenRestrictionComparison h W).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) =
    (schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y W).map ((schemeMVDirectImageLocalization h).app I)

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-open-restriction-normalization] to the homotopy quotient of the input complex, without assuming K-injectivity.

Rewrite the restriction chain by [lem-pc-mayer-vietoris-restriction-chain-quotient-transport], replace the resulting homotopy restriction chain by the normalization equation, and cancel the inverse exact restriction factor under the restricted derived direct-image functor. Use naturality of schemeMVOpenRestrictionComparison with quotientCompQhIso to move the last quotient comparison past the restriction comparison and cancel its hom/inverse pair. Expand schemeMVDirectImageLocalization to identify the remaining composite.

Use the explicit four-map chain [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-restriction-localization-chain] as the shared intermediate map. Its declared endpoints keep downstream categorical composition from unfolding the derived constructions.
